summary: Meta Platforms filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a $15.0 billion five-tranche senior unsecured note offering: $3.25B 5.850% due 2031, $3.25B 6.250% due 2033, $4.0B 6.550% due 2036, $1.75B 7.350% due 2046, and $2.75B 7.500% due 2056. Interest pays semi-annually beginning May 15, 2027; notes are redeemable at stated prices and are unsecured, ranking pari passu with other senior unsecured debt. Net proceeds of roughly $14.947B before expenses, with Citigroup and Morgan Stanley as joint book-running managers. Settlement expected November 5, 2026. This is a routine investment-grade debt capital raise, not a special situation; watch spreads and use of proceeds.
